description: This file contains implementation of the QuicFramerPeer class with static methods for testing and manipulating QuicFramer objects in the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicFramerPeer
classes.description: A testing utility class providing static methods to manipulate and access private members of QuicFramer objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: CalculatePacketNumberFromWire
methods.description: Calculates packet number from wire format using a QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: SetLastSerializedServerConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the last serialized server connection ID in a QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: SetLastSerializedClientConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the last serialized client connection ID in a QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: SetLastWrittenPacketNumberLength
methods.description: Sets the last written packet number length in a QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: SetLargestPacketNumber
methods.description: Sets the largest packet number in a QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: SetPerspective
methods.description: Sets the perspective (client/server) in a QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: SwapCrypters
methods.description: Swaps encrypter and decrypter objects between two QuicFramer instances.

methods.name: GetEncrypter
methods.description: Retrieves the encrypter for a specific encryption level from a QuicFramer.

methods.name: GetDecrypter
methods.description: Retrieves the decrypter for a specific encryption level from a QuicFramer.

methods.name: SetFirstSendingPacketNumber
methods.description: Sets the first sending packet number in a QuicFramer.

methods.name: SetExpectedServerConnectionIDLength
methods.description: Sets the expected server connection ID length in a QuicFramer.

methods.name: GetLargestDecryptedPacketNumber
methods.description: Gets the largest decrypted packet number for a given packet number space.

methods.name: ProcessAndValidateIetfConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Processes and validates IETF connection ID length from a QuicDataReader.
